facts.fact: The Autorite de protection's decisions register lists decision no. 2024-0996 of 16 January 2024 giving a warning and formal notice to the ministry METFPA and the company Kaydan Groupe on data protection.
The Autorite de protection's own register lists its normative, authorisation and sanction decisions from 2016 to January 2024 under loi no. 2013-450.
